Pacing Calendar, 2026-27

Unified Dashboard: The Dashboardnow combines this day-by-day pacing schedule with your lesson progress and one-click build links. This page provides the compact full-year print view.

Every B-day of the school year, mapped to its work. Built from the IBW Trivory calendar (trivory.com/ibw/calendar, read Sept 2026). The class meets on B days only; this calendar is the contract between the syllabus and the clock.

The shape: the year opens with two weeks of Scratch — a get-to-know-you starter project where you meet the building blocks (sprites, loops, events) with zero engine overhead. On Sep 14 the first Unity project begins: we build one real game — a 2D RPG that becomes a 2D platformer when you enter a cave — from the cs-curriculum-main starter repo, ending with your own boss fight and the semester final (a normal B day, Jan 21). Second semester: the CSP big ideas Unity cannot teach alone (data, systems, impact), then three game jams, with the Create performance task dueFriday, April 30, 2027and the AP exam onFriday, May 14, 2027 at 8:00 AM (Session 1). The exam is an A-day Friday morning — you take it before school-day classes start. After it: Season 2 jams, for the love of the game.All 10 CED topic families are covered by the exam.

Thu Nov 12, 2026Lesson5.3Into the Cave: Persistence & the HUD
The architectural payoff. Leaving the overworld destroys every stat the student owns, because a scene load replaces rather than loses. The StatManager from 2.7 is the answer; today they verify it does its three jobs - one original, surviving the load, and clamping - and then build the HUD that shows health and coins where the game begins. Calendar sources: IBW Trivory calendar (trivory.com/ibw/calendar, read Sept 2026) — 82 regular B days plus the Jan 21 finals B day, Sep 1-Jun 3. No-school days this year: Oct 9 + Oct 14, Veterans Day (Nov 11), Thanksgiving week (Nov 23-27), winter break (Dec 21-Jan 1), MLK Day (Jan 18), semester break (Jan 25-26), Presidents Day (Feb 15), Mar 3, spring break (Mar 22-26), Memorial Day (May 31). Snow days are not modeled; if one lands on a B day, shift work forward and let the placeholder jam days (Jun 1 + Jun 3) absorb it. June finals (Jun 4-8) carry no A/B label — the semester 2 final meets on this course's block during finals week.
